tells.1: Excessive exclamation marks and unnatural phrasing such as 'The possibility to play with a 5th player!'
tells.2: Bold bullet lead-ins and formulaic triads ('More explorers, more crossings, more arguments')
tells.3: Parallel triadic phrasing in both bullets ('More explorers, more crossings, and more bickering' / 'New tools, new twists, and a few surprises')
tells.5: Stacked rule-of-three lists in prose ('more explorers, more crossings, and more arguments' and 'new tools, new twists, and a few surprises')
tells.7: Over-structured bold-bullet format and 'What's in the box' template phrasing

reason: Version 4 reads as the most naturally human, but version 3 is the best send because it has a clearer subject line, scannable value, and a warm, direct tone.
